target.note: CUSA00900 01.09 reproduced the six published hook-site byte sequences read-only, but no grant path has ever been installed there. Every other serial and app version must fail closed.

strategy: read the last eboot base_virtual_addr from shad_log.txt
verify it against both hook originals
otherwise AOB-scan the consume-return signature and require exactly one candidate
base_resolution.note: shadPS4 0.18 maps the eboot below 4 GiB at a launch-dependent address; v0.17 absolutes such as 0x8014DA0A0 are not a portable binding.

payload.note: VALIDATED 2026-08-24 against a live shadPS4 process. The CE table was loaded and armed, both caves read back with tools/compare_ce_payload.py, and the only differences were MR-form vs RM-form encodings of three reg-to-reg movs (mov rdi,r13 x2; mov rsi,rsp; mov esi,eax) -- semantically identical instructions. The assembler was switched to CE's RM-form encoding, so the shipped blob is now byte-identical to what CE emits. Owner checklist item 1 is complete.
